acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays live vehicle status and energy consumption; can schedule charging
kpi: Live status latency <5s; % vehicles adhering to scheduled charge > 95%

acceptance_criteria: Scheduler can create charging windows and apply tariffs; supports bulk scheduling
kpi: % charging during off-peak hours; reduced energy cost per vehicle

acceptance_criteria: App preserves job data offline and syncs when online; offline nav available
kpi: Sync success rate; average time to sync < 30s

acceptance_criteria: Vehicle supports V2H mode with safe isolation and user control; power delivery meets spec
kpi: kW delivered to external load; safe disconnect events=0

acceptance_criteria: Automated KPI rollups and sustainability metrics are available daily
kpi: Report generation success; KPI coverage vs targets

requirement: Export and API access to vehicle/energy data
acceptance_criteria: APIs expose historical and real-time data with documented schema
kpi: API uptime; requests/second; completeness of data exports

acceptance_criteria: User can configure preferences and profiles that persist across sessions
kpi: % users with completed profiles; NPS for personalization

acceptance_criteria: OTAs delivered securely, versioned, and rollback supported
kpi: Successful update rate; mean time to recover (MTR) on failed update

acceptance_criteria: Alerts generated with recommended actions and confidence scores
kpi: Reduction in unplanned downtime; precision/recall of alerts

acceptance_criteria: Automated periodic reports with source data and export formats
kpi: kWh and emissions reported per vehicle per period; report accuracy

acceptance_criteria: Bulk orders, digital warranties and service agreements supported
kpi: Time to fulfill bulk order; procurement cycle time

acceptance_criteria: Documentation bundle provided for procurement and audit
kpi: Completeness of compliance checklist; audit pass rate
